title: Can Large Language Models Review the Scientific Literature? A Test Against a 102-Article Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.05459v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support scientific literature reviews, yet evaluations often examine individual tasks rather than the review process as a whole. We assess six AI tools across four stages: finding relevant articles, interpreting them, synthesizing across them, and proposing future research. The benchmark is a published review of the Spanish plume weather pattern and its 102-article corpus.   In the initial searches, five tools collectively identified 57 articles, with the best individual tool finding 42. Institutional library access increased discovery from 42 to 82 articles for Codex and from 15 to 79 for Claude Code. Given the complete corpus of 102 PDFs, three tools correctly identified all 18 articles discussing the Spanish plume substantially, but incorrectly classified 40% to 79% of the 84 passing mentions as substantial. translated_title: 大语言模型能否完成科学文献综述？基于102篇文献基准的测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于支持科学文献综述，但现有评估通常只考察单个任务，而非将综述过程作为一个整体来检验。我们在四个阶段评估了六种AI工具：查找相关文章、解读文章、跨文章综合归纳，以及提出未来研究方向。测试基准是一篇已发表的关于西班牙羽流（Spanish plume）天气型的综述文章及其102篇文献的语料库。在初始检索中，五种工具合计识别出57篇文章，表现最好的单个工具找到42篇。借助机构图书馆访问权限，Codex的文献发现量从42篇提升至82篇，Claude Code从15篇提升至79篇。在给定全部102篇PDF文献的情况下，三种工具正确识别出了所有18篇实质性讨论西班牙羽流的文章，但将84篇仅顺带提及的文献中的40%至79%错误地判定为实质性讨论。同样这三种工具所生成的综述内容由两位领域专家进行盲评……
tldr: 该研究以一篇含102篇文献的天气学综述为基准，对六种AI工具在文献综述全流程（检索、解读、综合、展望）进行评估，发现LLM虽有可取之处，但在文献发现能力以及区分实质性引用与顺带提及方面仍存在明显局限。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks six AI tools across the full literature-review process using a 102-article weather-pattern review corpus, finding that while LLMs show promise in interpreting and synthesizing literature, they still fall short in article discovery and in reliably distinguishing substantive citations from passing mentions.
